text:
matt-runtime: Planning a sharded router cutover tonight 02:00 UTC. This touches api, runtime, console. Need final sign-off on version pins and rollback signals.

Sequence proposal:
1) Pin runtime -> v2.3.1-rt
2) Deploy router shard batches (canary 5%, 25%, 100%)
3) Shift routing and unpin console

Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Anyone object?

kevin-api: ACK. API will pin to v2.3.1 and hold merges during the window.

anya-console: Console team: we can hold unpin until canary passes. Will flip console UI to read-only during cutover. I’ll push config at +10m.

deploy-bot: @channel deploy scheduled by matt-runtime
```
/deploy router --shards="shard-{1..4}" --image=router:v2026.3 --canary=5% --notify=ops
```
Queued for 1967005600 UTC

sam-router: fyi, eu-west nodes had a slow drain on last run. Proposal: drain eu-west first, then us-east. If canary p95 > 200ms, abort and rollback.

rachel-sre: SRE monitoring ready. Alert policy set:
- router_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> page
- router_p95_latency > 250ms -> auto-rollback trigger

matt-runtime: Rollback plan (short):
```
1) abort deploy and mark shards as rollback
2) pin traffic to runtime v2.3.0: /routing pin --runtime=v2.3.0
3) restore previous router weights: /routing set-weights --snapshot=pre-cutover
4) console: remove read-only
```
If we hit soft failures (timeout spikes but no 5xx), we do staged revert: reduce canary to 1% then monitor.

kevin-api: noted. Will keep an eye on autodeploy hooks.

anya-console: tagging ops: @rachel-sre @sam-router please ack when you see deploy-bot start.

rachel-sre: ack, will confirm at each canary step. :white_check_mark:

sam-router: ack. ops -> standing by for manual abort if needed.

matt-runtime: thanks all. I’ll start the scheduled deploy if no objections in 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
